text: A later discovery test fix changes addSubfolder to getChildNamed. Current checkFoldersDiscovered retrieves each expected nested folder and asserts it is not null before inspecting cached databases. Preserve lookup-only checks here: creating the expected folder during verification can hide a discovery failure. The test separately awaits an Inbox update before database assertions. Its fixed delay for discovery remains historical test context, not a recommended general waiting style. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or live accessibility validation was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
title: Assert discovered IMAP folders without creating them inside the check
